The Process

How It Works

01
Find Your Scent

Take the 30-second quiz or browse the collection. Pick a fragrance, a size (2 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20ml), and add it to your cart.

02
Build Your Order

Mix and match across fragrances. Bundle 3, 5, 8, or 12 decants for automatic discounts up to S$20 off.

03
Checkout & Pay

Hit checkout — we open WhatsApp with your full order pre-filled. Confirm and we'll send PayNow / PayLah details.

04
Delivered to You

We deliver anywhere in Singapore — flat S$5.50 delivery fee, free on orders over S$75.

Why Scentral

The Difference

A decant shop run by people who actually love fragrance — not a dropshipper, not a reseller.

Authenticity Guaranteed

Hand-decanted from a personal authenticated collection.

Every fragrance we sell is sourced from authorised retailers and official boutiques in Singapore and abroad — never from grey-market resellers, never replicas. Each decant is hand-poured from a full bottle in our own collection, so what arrives in your vial is exactly what's in the parent bottle. Proof of authenticity available on request.

Authenticated Stock

Bought from official boutiques and authorised retailers — invoices on request.

Five Decant Sizes

2 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 20ml. Pick a sampler or a daily driver — your call, no minimums.

Fair Singapore Pricing

No mark-ups. Try Layton or Black Orchid for the price of a coffee — not S$400.

Honest Recommendations

Take the quiz or ask us — we'll match you to a scent based on what you actually like.

Flat S$5.50 Delivery

Under S$75? Delivery anywhere in Singapore is a flat S$5.50 — no minimum order.

Free Delivery Over S$75

Hit a S$75 order and we'll deliver anywhere in Singapore — your door, your school, your office. No fees, ever.
